cards.ex: She's in her fifties but maintains a remarkably youthful appearance.
cards.exUz: U ellik yoshda, lekin ajoyib darajada yosh ko'rinishni saqlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Yoshga nisbatan yoshroq ko'rinish, yoshlikni saqlab qolgan.

cards.ex: The famine left many with gaunt features and hollow eyes.
cards.exUz: Ocharchilik ko'pchilikni ozg'in xususiyatlar va chuqur ko'zlar bilan qoldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ozg'in, kasallik yoki ochlikdan kelib chiqqan yuz qiyofasi.

cards.ex: His unkempt appearance suggested he hadn't slept in days.
cards.exUz: Uning tartibsiz ko'rinishi bir necha kundan beri uxlamaganligini ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Tozalanmagan, tartibsiz va yomon ko'rinish.

cards.ex: She had a statuesque figure that always drew attention.
cards.exUz: Uning doim e'tiborni tortadigan haykaltarosh qomati bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Haykalga o'xshagan, baland bo'yli va mukammal proportsiyalarga ega qomat.

cards.ex: There's a striking resemblance between her and her mother when she was young.
cards.exUz: U bilan onasining yoshligidagi o'rtasida hayratlanarli o'xshashlik bor.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli o'xshashlik, diqqatni tortadigan darajada.

cards.ex: She's been trying to lose weight for her wedding.
cards.exUz: U to'yi uchun vazn yo'qotishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tana vaznini kamaytirish.

cards.ex: He put on weight after he stopped playing sports.
cards.exUz: U sport o'ynashni to'xtatgandan keyin vazn yig'di.
cards.uzDef: Tana vaznini oshirish.

cards.ex: His distinctive features made him easily recognizable.
cards.exUz: Uning ajralib turuvchi xususiyatlari uni oson taniladigan qildi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan farq qiladigan, o'ziga xos qiyofa belgilari.

cards.ex: She has a great dress sense and always looks fashionable.
cards.exUz: Uning ajoyib kiyinish uslubi bor va har doim zamonaviy ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Odamning kiyim tanlash va kombinatsiyalash qobiliyati.

cards.ex: They were struggling financially, but they tried to keep up appearances.
cards.exUz: Ular moddiy jihatdan qiynalishardi, lekin ko'rinishni saqlashga harakat qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining moddiy ahvoli yoki baxtli ekanligini ko'rsatishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I had a splitting headache after staring at the screen all day.
cards.exUz: Kun bo'yi ekranga tikilib qarab o'tirganimdan keyin qattiq bosh og'rig'i bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli, o'ta og'riqli bosh og'rig'i.

cards.ex: He won the lead role thanks to his dashing looks and charisma.
cards.exUz: U o'zining kelishgan ko'rinishi va xarizmasi tufayli bosh rolni qo'lga kiritdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda chiroyli va hayratlanarli ko'rinish.

cards.ex: She walked in with a fresh face, ready to start the day.
cards.exUz: U yangi yuz bilan xonaga kirdi, kunni boshlashga tayyor.
cards.uzDef: Yangi, sog'lom va jozibali ko'rinadigan yuz.

cards.ex: He had a haggard look after working non-stop for days.
cards.exUz: U bir necha kun tinimsiz ishlagandan keyin xarob ko'rinishga ega edi.
cards.uzDef: Charchoq, kasallik yoki tashvishdan xarob bo'lib qolgan ko'rinish.

cards.ex: Problems always seem to crop up when you least expect them.
cards.exUz: Muammolar har doim kutmaganingizda paydo bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmaganda paydo bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: I need to get into shape before the summer holidays.
cards.exUz: Men yozgi ta'tilga qadar formaga kirishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy holatini yaxshilash, sport bilan shug'ullanib, sog'lom bo'lish.

cards.ex: He's a bit scruffy looking, but he's got a heart of gold.
cards.exUz: U biroz qashshoq ko'rinadi, lekin qalbi oltindan ham qimmat.
cards.uzDef: Notozda, tartibsiz va g'alati ko'rinish.

cards.ex: He carries his weight well for his age.
cards.exUz: U yoshi uchun vaznini yaxshi olib yuradi.
cards.uzDef: Tana og'irligini o'zida olib yurmoq.

cards.ex: He started to go bald in his early thirties.
cards.exUz: U o'ttiz yoshlarida kal bo'lishni boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Sochning to'kilishi natijasida kal bo'lib qolish.

cards.ex: She has a naturally radiant complexion.
cards.exUz: Uning tabiiy ravishda nurli terisi bor.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lom va porlab turgan teri.

cards.ex: She walked into the room with an air of confidence.
cards.exUz: U xonaga o'ziga ishonch havosi bilan kirdi.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga ishonchli va qat'iy ko'rinish.

cards.ex: She's been trying to slim down before her vacation.
cards.exUz: U ta'tilga chiqishdan oldin ozishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tana vaznini kamaytirish, ozish.

cards.ex: She cut a striking figure in her red dress.
cards.exUz: U qizil libosda ajoyib qiyofa yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: E'tiborni tortadigan, ajoyib tashqi ko'rinishga ega shaxs.

cards.ex: Don't judge people based solely on their outward appearance.
cards.exUz: Odamlarni faqat tashqi ko'rinishiga qarab baholamang.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsning tashqi ko'rinishi, tashqi qiyofasi.

cards.ex: She decided to get a makeover after her divorce.
cards.exUz: U ajrashgandan keyin tashqi ko'rinishini o'zgartirishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi soch turmagi, bo'yanish va kiyim-kechak bilan ko'rinishni o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: He made a passable appearance at the meeting, despite being tired.
cards.exUz: U charchaganiga qaramay, uchrashuvda maqbul ko'rinish yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Qoniqarli, lekin ajoyib bo'lmagan ko'rinish.

cards.ex: He was always dressed impeccably, no matter the occasion.
cards.exUz: U har doim mukammal kiyingan, qanday vaziyat bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar.
cards.uzDef: Bepul kamchiliksiz, juda yaxshi kiyingan.

cards.ex: She exercises regularly to keep her figure.
cards.exUz: U qomatini saqlash uchun muntazam ravishda mashq qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Ozishni saqlash, qomatni yaxshi holatda saqlash.

cards.ex: The city's beauty began to lose its lustre after years of neglect.
cards.exUz: Shahar go'zalligi yillar davomidagi e'tiborsizlikdan keyin jilosini yo'qota boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Jozibasini yoki yorqinligini yo'qotmoq.

cards.ex: She has an alluring appearance that attracts attention.
cards.exUz: Uning diqqatni tortadigan jozibali ko'rinishi bor.
cards.uzDef: Juda jozibali va yoqimli ko'rinish.
